title: paper2db.answer-pointer.v1
description: Store of answer pointers for one corpus (qb or dse): where the worked answer / marking scheme for an item lives. Merged per item by tier (verified > derived > inferred) via scripts/pointers.py.

item_id.description: qb: PHY1... item id. dse: dse-mc-<year>-<q> or dse-lq-<year>-q<n>.

tier.description: verified = human-checked; derived = located deterministically from a source (e.g. marking-scheme crop); inferred = heuristic or LLM guess. Higher tier wins on merge.

path.description: Relative to paper2db/, forward slashes, no '..' segments.

bbox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] as page fractions, x0<x1 and y0<y1.

source.description: Provenance: script, reviewer or document that produced the pointer.
